_comment: Second sample: a MULTI-DEALER setup review (Yamaha / Inovatec, 2026-09). Exercises `status_rows` (explicit item/id/status/note table) rather than a parsed checks_md, a PASS verdict, and a key question aimed at Account Management. Used by verify_emory.ps1 as the status_rows smoke test. Never posted.
title: Yamaha Protection Plan - Inovatec dealer rating status
dealer: Ghostrider (YM900149) and eight other Yamaha / Inovatec dealers
product: YMBG Boat DWA, YMGP Powersport DWA, APVS Powersport VSC, YMRS Roadside
reported: Ed Durrant, 09/21/26 - follow-up on the Inovatec dealer-code ticket
summary: Root cause was an incorrect dealer code configured in Inovatec, not a Safe-Guard rating issue.
Safe-Guard was able to rate products successfully throughout the investigation.
Inovatec corrected the dealer mapping on 9/3 and testing immediately passed.
Ghostrider has since sold products, confirming the issue was resolved.
One follow-up remains: tell Sam, Zach and Mark the issue is fixed and close the original ticket.

status_rows.note: Still failing - enrolled for Boat DWA only

key_question: Was Valley Chainsaw intentionally enrolled only for Boat DWA, or should they also carry Motorcycle / Powersport products?
actions: Notify Sam, Zach and Mark that the Ghostrider dealer-code issue is fixed and close the original ticket.
If Valley Chainsaw should carry powersport products, raise a DCR to add the Powersport DWA and VSC assignments on YM795720.
Retest Dockside (YM795710) now that it is enrolled.
owner: Account Management (Canada) - confirmation only; no Safe-Guard defect identified
checks_md:
1. Dealer status - PASS - all nine codes resolve to active EAS dealers except M&P Mercury (not enrolled)
2. Product assigned - PASS - YMBG/YMGP/APVS/YMRS open to 9999-12-31 on the eight enrolled codes; Valley Chainsaw carries YMBG only
3. eContract forms - PASS - YMBDWA-CAN-822 and YMMDWACAN-822 eContract-enabled
4. Rates - PASS - rate systems 1312/1307/1308/1278 open; RATE_SKU_YAMAHA live rows present
5. Vehicle eligibility - SKIPPED - no VIN supplied
0. Duplicate check - NOT checked - no VIN or SR
root_cause:
Inovatec had Ghostrider mapped to the wrong Safe-Guard dealer code, so its requests resolved to a shell with no products. Corrected 2026-09-03; DEALER_PRODUCT_CODE for dealer_id 58271 (program 20336) shows APVS/YMBG/YMGP/YMRS open and SG_CON_M1 shows YMRS contracts on 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-07.

Valley Chainsaw (YM795720) is correctly mapped but enrolled on YMBG (Boat DWA) only, so any motorcycle/ATV/snowmobile request returns an empty product list: "No products were available for this dealer." That is working as configured, not an API fault.
verification: Ghostrider live - DEALER_PRODUCT_CODE for dealer_id 58271 returned 4 open rows (APVS, YMBG, YMGP, YMRS) with EXPIRATION_SALE_DATE 9999-12-31.
Ghostrider transacting - SG_CON_M1 where SG_CON_DEALER = YM900149 returned 2 YMRS contracts, status A, 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-07.
Valley Chainsaw scope - DEALER_PRODUCT_CODE for YM795720 returned a single open row, YMBG; RATE_SYSTEM_APPLICATION shows only rate system 1307.
Working dealers - the six YM codes marked working each returned open product rows and open rate systems for YMBG and YMGP in DEALER_PRODUCT_CODE / RATE_SYSTEM_APPLICATION.
M&P Mercury - no row in V_DEALER for any YM code matching the name; reported to Inovatec as not enrolled.
